label: Price / Earnings (P/E)
short_definition: Price divided by trailing twelve-month diluted EPS.

label: Price / Sales
short_definition: Market cap relative to trailing twelve-month revenue.

label: Price / Book
short_definition: Market cap relative to stockholders' equity.

label: FCF yield
short_definition: Trailing twelve-month free cash flow relative to market cap.

label: EV / EBITDA
short_definition: Enterprise value relative to trailing twelve-month EBITDA.
formula_description: (Market Cap + Total Debt - Cash & Equivalents) / EBITDA (TTM)
perimeter: D2026-11-04.5 total debt incl. finance leases

label: EV / Sales
short_definition: Enterprise value relative to trailing twelve-month revenue.
formula_description: (Market Cap + Total Debt - Cash & Equivalents) / Revenue (TTM)
perimeter: D2026-11-04.5 total debt incl. finance leases

label: PEG ratio
short_definition: Trailing P/E divided by year-over-year EPS growth.
formula_description: Trailing P/E / EPS Growth Rate (YoY, as a percentage number, e.g. 15 not 0.15)
